method: Manually reviewed official university, lab and researcher recruitment pages. Named-person identity and opportunity subject determine subfield placement. Institutional funding is context only and never confers open status. Advertised opportunities and standing invitations are distinguished; neither guarantees acceptance or remaining capacity. Review dates are at most 90 days after checking. Dates are evaluated again in the browser. This is a small, non-exhaustive reviewed sample, with uneven field and geographic coverage.
